audit.whatIsWrong: Every one of the seven full-layer rows disagreed with the content win[] and the packet levelChart. The full layer gave LeBlanc levels 1-5 and Skill from 6 onward; the content layer gives Skill through 4-5, LeBlanc at 6 and first item, and Lissandra at two items.
audit.why: Pre-6 LeBlanc has no combo that beats a 725 Q from range — Ethereal Chains needs 1.5 seconds of shackle to root. Her actual spike is Mimic at 6 (45/35/25s) doubling a burst rotation. Late, your point-and-click R is the only reliable catch on her and her single-target burst stops deleting a Zhonya's Lissandra.
audit.corrected: Full sides realigned to Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, LeBlanc, LeBlanc, Lissandra with all seven whys rewritten to argue their rows.

audit.why: Levels 3-5 chain burst, level 6 Mimic, first-item one-rotation, and the late inversion are all in the content spikes and are accurate to the kit.
audit.corrected: Left as-is; the phase whys now key to Mimic's and Distortion's real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two interactions that decide the lane were never stated: Distortion's 4-second return window as your root target, and Mirror Image firing below 40% health with a 1-second invisibility.
audit.why: Distortion is 15s falling to 10s at 600 range and can be reactivated for 4 seconds to return; rooting inside that window strands her. Mirror Image makes the low-health chase a coin flip on which body you are hitting. Sigil of Malice is 6s flat and only detonates when a second ability hits.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt with those numbers; tradeGood keyed to the return window; dontsFull[2].d now explains Mirror Image instead of repeating tradeBad.
